review_notes: Inspected all 82 target lines and the imported RealSobolev and NormalizedPoisson sources. The same chart-cover/local-Laplacian argument appears in the target and in RealSmooth.complexL_real; I found no other repeated nontrivial proof machinery that clearly meets the rubric.

findings.excerpt:
obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := A.covers x
  change g.laplacianValue (SmoothRealFunction.constant c) x = 0
  rw [g.laplacianValue_local _ i hi, g.linearizedMongeAmpere_constant]
  rfl
findings.problem: This global-to-local proof of the Laplacian of a constant repeats the same chart-cover, local Laplacian formula, and constant linearized-Monge–Ampère calculation already used to prove that complexL preserves real-valuedness. Keeping the general result only in this later-imported file leaves the earlier proof unable to reuse it.
findings.proposed_change: Move a shared lemma into RealSobolev.lean, where both proofs can use it: `lemma laplacian_constant (g : KaehlerMetric A) (c : ℝ) : g.laplacian (SmoothRealFunction.constant c) = SmoothRealFunction.constant 0 := by apply SmoothRealFunction.ext_value; funext x; obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := A.covers x; change g.laplacianValue (SmoothRealFunction.constant c) x = 0; rw [g.laplacianValue_local _ i hi, g.linearizedMongeAmpere_constant]; rfl`. Then remove this duplicate declaration from the target. In RealSobolev.complexL_real, replace the chart-local calculation after `rw [hi]` with a use of the shared lemma to reduce the Laplacian of `constant 0`; in the target, retain `rw [complexL_im, Smooth.ofReal_part_im, laplacian_constant]` in complexL_ofReal. The target already imports RealSobolev, and the displayed shared statement uses hypotheses and names already in scope there.
findings.benefit: Readers can recognize one reusable geometric fact instead of maintaining two proofs of the same localization argument. Generalizing the helper to every real constant also lets the existing real-valuedness proof use the exact case it needs.
